ibnmajah:2310: Ali reports Yemen appointment, request, chest-touch and prayer, then his own absence of later uncertainty. Judge capacity and young predicates are actual role/state qualifiers, not lexical definitions; retain both. Urdu footnote is context.
ibnmajah:2329: AbuHurayra reports two animal claimants without witnesses and explicit Prophet instruction to draw lots for oaths. No outside litigant identities. Urdu footnote context.
ibnmajah:2332: IbnMuhayyisah reports Bara camel damage and explicit Messenger ruling with distinct day-property-owner/night-animal-owner responsibility. Preserve all source wording, time conditions and Urdu defective grammar. Footnote context.
ibnmajah:2345: Imran reports six slaves, no other property, deathbed freeing, then Messenger grouping and lot-selected freeing of two/retention of four. Parentheses describing three groups of two, drawing lots and which selected two are actual numerical/action/recipient scope; preserve them rather than treating them as dictionary glosses.
ibnmajah:2346: AbuHurayra reports a sale dispute, no witnesses and an oath-lot order regardless of parties satisfaction. The deciding actor is given only by honorific pronoun, with no explicit personal name in either own field; qualify rather than supply one. Hindi sale synonym is lexical context.
ibnmajah:2349: Aisha explicitly names Messenger joyful arrival and recounts his nested account of Mujazziz observing Usama/Zayd feet with heads covered and his comparison. Preserve all nested speakers and exact names; Urdu footnote context.
ibnmajah:2352: Rafi reports parents dispute, one unbelieving/one Muslim, source-named Rafi choice, change of inclination after Prophet prayer and residence order. Parenthetic Rafi identity disambiguates the choice recipient amid the two parents; the actual with-whomever choice scope stays. Final Muslim label repeats the immediately stated selected parent and can remain explanatory context without changing the outcome.
muslim:2313: Jabir reports post-death emancipation condition, owner no other property, sale and successive spending priorities, then narrator-described gestures. Preserve the timed emancipation condition, each if-something-remains condition and the narrator-said voice marker; final Urdu spend imperative is actual predicate. Duplicate800 digits and redundant slave object label are apparatus; no absent transfer-of-money detail is filled.
muslim:2320: UmmSalama through the printed chain asks reward for supporting AbuSalama children, states they are her children, and receives explicit Messenger affirmative answer. Complete own Q&A, no apparatus except honorifics; preserve malformed Urdu punctuation.
muslim:2324: Asma asks the Messenger about her arriving mother, with two expressly alternative desire/fear predicates, then kinship question and yes answer. Parentheses supply what is desired and what is feared; they are meaningful object/circumstance qualifiers, not word synonyms. Preserve both alternatives and their source uncertainty.
muslim:2325: Asma reports treaty-period arrival of her polytheist mother and asks Messenger about kinship. Parenthetic from-me-kinship hope object supplies the mother expectation; retain the source temporal/religious qualifiers without external dating.
muslim:2327: Chain/similarity apparatus surrounds an actual finite negative variant: she did not make a will, supplied as Arabic/transliteration and translation. That fragment can be retained under the named AbuUsama transmission with the woman and ultimate speaker unknown. Do not fill the preceding account; other transmitters omitted-word discussion remains context.
muslim:2331: Two actual finite variant fragments are printed: or commanded right, and he will reach evening that day/in that condition. Keep exact fragments/translations with actor and missing condition unnamed. And-instead-of metalinguistic words are context. Hindi omits part of Urdu chain; do not fill it. Two fragments of the same transmitted variant family, no inferred Prophet voice.
muslim:2344: Two named-route transmitted charity-placement variants have finite wording and complete source translations. Preserve actual Arabic/transliteration plus both parenthetic translations; these are quoted body translations, not lexical apparatus. One alternative-wording family, ultimate source actor unknown. Urdu explicitly identifies Ruh first; Hindi first variant lacks that individual label, so do not import it.
muslim:2349: Adi reports explicit Messenger gestures, fire warning, half-date/fallback speech and the observers as-if impression. Keep epistemic as-if scope; Urdu even-this qualifies the fallback object. Compiler absence-of-kaannama and terminal chain discussion remain context; redundant fire-object label can stay context without altering the nearby explicit fire referent.
muslim:2352: Mundhir father supplies finite morning co-presence with Messenger. An IbnMuadh addition separately supplies actual Dhuhr prayer and sermon, inside a larger pointer parenthesis. Admit both actual parts as same account family; omission/preceding-report pointer stays context. Urdu present qualifier is actual copular-state wording, not merely chain apparatus.
muslim:2353: Mundhir father supplies finite seated-near-Prophet arrival of poorly dressed group, then after omitted middle actual Dhuhr/minbar/praise and printed fear-your-Lord recitation. Preserve two finite parts in one family and only actual quotation; whole-story and verse-to-end pointers remain context.
muslim:2354: Jarir supplies finite Bedouin/wool/poor-and-hungry arrival before Messenger. The complete finite opening is admissible; following omitted/same-meaning pointer is context, with no recovered sermon filled.
muslim:2355: AbuMasud reports commanded charity with no named commanding actor, burden carrying, AbuAqil/other donations, hypocrites actual words and narrator revelation claim with printed verse translation. Do not turn passive command into a named Prophet quotation. Wage gloss and terminal Bishr word-omission apparatus are context; narrator quotation/recitation stays.
muslim:2356: Saeed ibnRabi route supplies finite we-carried-on-our-backs wording. It is an abbreviated reported first-person plural statement, not Saeed/AbuDawud own eyewitness action unless the source names them as the actors, which it does not. Same-chain frame does not supply the omitted body.
muslim:2357: AbuHurayra transmits with the printed raised-to-honorific-referent attribution marker. Preserve that marker and actual milk-yielding camel conditional recipient/domain; morning/evening full-bowl conditions stay. The final camel label repeats the already explicit animal and is explanatory context.
muslim:2365: All five fields supply only same-chain and a prepositional food-of-her-husband wording replacement. No finite action, condition predicate, report question or body exists in any field. Resolve as source-only without constructing the missing act from a preceding report.
muslim:2369: Umayr reports master meat instruction, poor-person feeding, beating, his own Messenger complaint, master reply and Messenger reward ruling. Recipient others is substantive scope of the master complaint; final both-will-receive gloss merely repeats the already stated shared reward and is context.
muslim:2382: AbuHurayra reports explicit Messenger question/answer on greatest charity. Parenthetic reward domain, at-that-time and then sequence, your-life actor of throat-reaching, and heir identity of final recipient each supply source scope/actor/time rather than bare synonym. Preserve them and all health/desire/fear/wealth/last-moment conditions; no named heir inferred.
muslim:2384: Transmitted abbreviated question which charity is best is actual finite interrogative wording after the comparison pointer. Retain only the supplied question/its binding frame, with questioner and ultimate addressee unknown; no answer or persons imported from2382.
